scope: independent on-target training/search; total NAM gates then CX; no historical witness or model transfer
state: general ZX multigraph; raw state never overwritten by its scoring view; macro actions explicitly transition via that view
scoring: verified frozen fixed-wire completion/NAM cleanup; on failure/mismatch repair a separate copy with clifford_simp then full_reduce; first valid branch, exact view-key cache
unscored: verified legal child remains active and enters separate latent FIFO; actual cost=null; reward 0 until next success, then delta from last scored anchor
dedup: exact raw state archive/cost cache and within-proposal signatures; no permanent hard action suppression
proposals: 12 general-phase families; finite matching/candidates and per-template phase-operation budget 128
observation: raw colored multigraph + separate normalized graph, boundary correspondences, rule/direction/phase/shape, eight explicit context values
sampling: NumPy search/restart RNG separate from deterministic state/visit proposal RNG and torch PPO shuffle; frozen/online same init
reward: last successfully scored NAM delta / 10; no invented latent cost
verification: each unique raw/view state full fixed-wire operator; every unique QASM independent Qiskit operator; unit-modulus phase only
timing: setup/final model excluded; matching, state export/verification/extraction, graph objects, restart maintenance and PPO inside wall budget
limits: candidate/node/matching/horizon/latent-depth bounds; extraction failures are legal transitions, verification/resource failures rejected
hh: I_X backward / H forward / I_Z forward proof; every contextual cancellation has a replay receipt
invalid_extraction: quarantined and excluded from all gate costs/rewards; legal raw graph can continue. Raw/repair operator mismatches remain fatal. Repairs apply identically in every arm.

active_rules.scope: Rules disabled before proposal construction; bounded menus do not imply complete search

verification_method: fixed-wire ZX identity reduction; scalar modulus tolerance1e-9; failure is inconclusive; zero errors in numeric fields are certificate placeholders, not measured operator errors

stop_rule.resets_on: strict reduction in total gates only; CX/depth ties do not reset

return_credit.scope: Gate-delta rewards unchanged. Optional success cutoff requires a strictly lower verified gate count than the known restart cost; unknown restart costs never trigger it. Gamma1/lambda1 gives undiscounted episode returns, with normal value bootstrap at collection-window cuts.

feasibility_mask: When enabled, rewrite-only previews exclude node/wire-budget violations before categorical sampling; no extraction/cost lookahead. Exact-state/action LRU; all preview work inside budget.

resource_bounds.scope: Bounds only certify candidates inside both resource budgets; uncertain cases use exact previews. Chosen rewrites retain all proof/operator checks.

rule_schedule.scope: Past strict total-gate improvements reset a sampled-transition counter. Staged mode alternates native-only and expanded windows; an empty native menu falls back to expanded rules. No completeness claim.

angle_support.representation: exact rational coefficients of pi from the pinned QASM parser
angle_support.jpv: 12 general-phase JPV schemata including A; exact affine inference and checked A constraints
angle_support.verification: existing numeric full-operator checks at 2e-8; C8 exact_tensor remains pi/4-only
angle_support.completeness: JPV Theorem 1.3 rule schemata; executable instances require real expressions and checked constraints; finite proposals are not complete search

symbolic_state: Exact expression records retained; numeric evaluation only for scoring. Native/macro transitions disabled while raw phases contain expressions.
